value.answer: Tomorrow (Tue) looks showery in Toronto. Expect about a 60% chance of showers, a risk of thunderstorms in the morning and afternoon, and 10 to 20 mm of rain. High is 24°C, with southwest wind gusting to 40 km/h near noon. Tuesday night drops to a low of 12°C, still cloudy with a fair chance of showers.
